yt_description:
What is vibe solutioning?

Vibe solutioning: describing a business problem, or adding a spreadsheet, and getting a complete, production-ready system: database, automations, apps and AI agents. No code to write or read.

Vibe coding gets you code you now have to debug, host and maintain. Vibe solutioning on Stackby gets you a working system: linked tables, approvals, role permissions, portals and dashboards, live today. And anyone on the team can change it.

In the video, one prompt turns a purchase-request spreadsheet into a Purchase Approval System with 3 linked tables, a 2-step approval flow, role permissions, a requester portal and a spend dashboard.
